data.desc: Founded in 1960, Domino's Pizza is the largest pizza company in the world, with a significant business in both delivery and carryout. It ranks among the world's top public restaurant brands with a global enterprise of more than 22,700 stores in over 90 markets. Domino's had global retail sales of over $20.7 billion in the trailing four quarters ended September 6, 2026. Its system is comprised of independent franchise owners who accounted for 99% of Domino's stores as of the end of the third quarter of 2026. In the U.S., Domino's generated more than 85% of U.S. retail sales in 2025 via digital channels and has developed many innovative ordering platforms.
